analysis: Post-hoc same-program/same-repeat comparison of reported exec_seconds; not a causal interference or statistical equivalence test.
formula: share2_over_serial = share2.exec_seconds / serial.exec_seconds; join by program, repeat; require one completed row per arm.
limits: exec_seconds is whole reported code execution, not GPU kernel time or queue-inclusive response time.
No different training seeds; three restarts of the same original seed per arm.
Cactus service-time variation remains unexplained; cache, CPU contention, thermal state and source timing variability are not separated.
DnCNN observed near-equal duration does not prove general absence of interference.
No pooling with 17005 or the incomplete 17021; no new candidate executions or quality outcomes.
Input, original-image and output/step equivalence checks remain in the primary audit and identity supplement.
